name: Blue Industrial Development
summary: Blue Industrial Development Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of paper and paper boards. Its products include core boards and liner boards. Core boards are used in the manufacture of paper cores and tubes. Liner boards are used in the manufacture of corrugated cardboard and boxes. It operates through the following business divisions: Paper, Corrugated Cardboard, and Other. The company was founded on July 18, 1970 and is headquartered in Pyeongtaek-si, South Korea.
